description: Defines an internal iterator interface 'RowIterator' and its implementations for converting between custom iterator and Scala's iterator, used within Spark SQL execution engine.

classes.name: RowIterator
classes.description: An abstract class providing a restricted iterator interface for Spark SQL internal processing.

classes.name: RowIteratorToScala
classes.description: Converts a RowIterator to a Scala Iterator, managing internal state for hasNext and next calls.

classes.name: RowIteratorFromScala
classes.description: Wraps a Scala Iterator to implement the RowIterator interface for Spark SQL.

methods.name: advanceNext
methods.description: Advances the iterator by one row, returning false if no more rows are available.

methods.name: getRow
methods.description: Retrieves the current row; idempotent, should not be called after advanceNext returns false.

methods.name: toScala
methods.description: Converts the RowIterator to a Scala Iterator of InternalRow.
